description: This file provides mock authentication service functions for a web application's frontend, including login, registration, session retrieval, and logout features. It interacts with an imported storage module to persist user data.

methods.name: getInitialUser()
methods.description: Loads the persisted user for session restore by retrieving it from storage.

methods.name: mockLogin({ email, password, role = 'member' })
methods.description: Simulates a login process by accepting user credentials and setting a mock user with a role.

methods.name: mockRegister({ email, password, role = 'member' })
methods.description: Simulates user registration by reusing login logic, creating a new user.

methods.name: logoutUser()
methods.description: Clears the user session data from storage, effectively logging out the user.
